en.name: Hailong Qu
en.degree: PhD student in Civil Engineering at Chongqing University
en.portrait: Profile image from Hailong Qu’s Google Scholar page
en.description: Hailong Qu is a PhD student at Chongqing University working on AI for Science, engineering agents and wind energy.
en.bio: I study how multimodal agents reason about space and use professional engineering software. My work in AI for Science also uses machine learning to predict offshore wind turbine loads, indoor air quality and the strength of structural materials.
en.tierHelp: 2026 Xinrui ranking, best tier across major and minor categories
en.intern: Engineering AI Research and Development Intern
en.intern1: Co-designed EngiWorld, ran model experiments and evaluated the files agents produced in professional engineering software.
en.intern2: Designed and tested software-development tasks for Micius-Flash, including a CAD hole-pattern plugin and a PySide6 implementation of Blender modeling workflows.

zh.name: 屈海龙
zh.degree: 重庆大学土木工程博士研究生
zh.portrait: 屈海龙的 Google 学术主页头像
zh.description: 屈海龙，重庆大学土木工程博士研究生。研究方向为科学智能、工程智能体和风能工程。
zh.bio: 我研究多模态智能体如何理解三维空间、操作专业工程软件。围绕科学智能（AI for Science），我也用机器学习预测海上风机载荷、室内空气质量和结构材料强度。
zh.cofirst: 共同第一作者，署名第二
zh.tierHelp: 2026 年新锐分区，取大类和小类中的最高分区
zh.intern: 工程智能体研发实习生
zh.intern1: 参与设计 EngiWorld 工程软件评测基准、运行模型实验，并检验智能体交付的工程文件。
zh.intern2: 为 Micius-Flash 设计并验证工程软件开发任务，包括编写 CAD 孔阵列插件，以及使用 PySide6 复现 Blender 建模工作流。
